en: A sixth straight record: revenue rose 128% to $269.9M, just above the ~$268M consensus, and non-GAAP EPS of $0.17 beat $0.14 as AOI posted a $6.3M GAAP profit. Data center sales jumped 254% to $155.6M and CATV rose 57% to $110.9M. The Q4 guide of $385–420M trails the ~$427M consensus, with EPS of $0.48–0.63 in line. CFO Stefan Murry cut the end-2026 capacity target to over 500,000 800G/1.6T units a month as US plants wait for power, while CEO Thompson Lin pointed to a new multi-year Tier 1 hyperscaler deal.

The report came after a rout: AI optical stocks fell for a second day on post-midterm data center worries and Coherent's results, and AOI dropped 20.9% to $46.89, about 80% below its 52-week high. Shares then slid about 10% more after hours as the light revenue guide and slower US build-out outweighed the beat. The first regular session after the report, on Nov 6, has not traded yet.
zh: 连续第六个季度创纪录：营收增长 128% 至 2.699 亿美元，略高于约 2.68 亿美元的市场预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 0.17 美元，超过 0.14 美元的预期，GAAP 净利润 630 万美元。数据中心收入大增 254% 至 1.556 亿美元，有线电视业务增长 57% 至 1.109 亿美元。第四季营收指引 3.85–4.2 亿美元，低于约 4.27 亿美元的预期，每股收益指引 0.48–0.63 美元符合预期。CFO 斯特凡·默里因美国工厂等待电力接入，将 2026 年底 800G/1.6T 月产能目标下调至逾 50 万件；CEO Thompson Lin 则强调新签的一级云厂商多年协议。
财报发布前股价已遭重挫：受中期选举后数据中心担忧及 Coherent 业绩影响，AI 光通信股连续第二天下跌，AOI 当日跌 20.9% 至 46.89 美元，较 52 周高点低约 80%。财报公布后，营收指引偏弱及美国扩产放缓盖过业绩超预期，股价盘后再跌约 10%。财报后首个常规交易日（11 月 6 日）尚未开盘。

bio.en: Founded AOI in 1997 in Sugar Land, Texas, and has led it as chairman and CEO since; holds a PhD in electrical engineering. Built a vertically integrated laser and transceiver maker with plants in Texas, Taiwan and China.
bio.zh: 1997 年在得州糖城创立 AOI，此后一直任董事长兼 CEO，拥有电子工程博士学位。将公司打造成垂直整合的激光器与光模块制造商，工厂分布在得州、台湾和中国大陆。

bio.en: A company lifer: joined AOI in 1997 as a device packaging engineer, ran sales and marketing, became chief strategy officer in 2012 and CFO in 2014. Holds a PhD in electrical engineering from the University of Houston.
bio.zh: 公司元老：1997 年以器件封装工程师身份加入，曾负责销售与市场，2012 年任首席战略官，2014 年起任 CFO。拥有休斯敦大学电子工程博士学位。
